name: New York State Conservation Partnership Program

funder.name: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation

summary: Matching grants administered with the Land Trust Alliance for qualified New York land trusts building capacity, stewardship, conservation partnerships and land protection projects.

eligibility.rule: Is a tax-exempt organization under Section 501(c)(3)
Has a primary mission conserving or stewarding private lands
Has formally adopted the Alliance's Land Trust Standards and Practices before applying

pool.quote: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation’s (DEC) Commissioner Amanda Lefton today announced $2.7 million is now available through DEC’s Conservation Partnership Program (CPP).

co_finance_required.quote: The New York State Conservation Partnership Program offers competitive matching grants to qualified New York land trusts

effort.quote: The deadline for all applications is Friday, Jan. 15, 2027, by 5 p.m. Eastern.

eligibility.quote: Applicant is a tax-exempt organization under Section 501 (c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code.
Applicants' primary mission is the conservation and/or stewardship of private lands.
Applicant has formally adopted the Alliance's Land Trust Standards and Practices (revised 2017) by submitting a board resolution to the Land Trust Alliance.

co_finance.quote: A minimum 25% match is required for all Conservation Partnership Program Grants. The match is based on the total project budget, with the grant funds covering up to 75% and the applicant match covering at least 25%. Depending on the grant category, the required match may be cash or a combination of cash and in-kind.

after_award.quote: Interim reports are due by April 30, 2028. Final reports are due 30 days after the end of the grant period or no later than April 30, 2029.
